Summary

CBACT03C is a batch COBOL program within the CardDemo application that reads and prints all records from an account cross-reference data file sequentially. It opens the indexed VSAM file, iterates through every record displaying each card cross-reference record to the output, and closes the file upon completion. This is a Main/Driver program with no external program calls other than an abend utility.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Display a message indicating the start of the Account Cross-Reference file reading and printing process 2: Open Account Cross-Reference File - Open the Account Cross-Reference data file to prepare it for sequential reading; terminate the program with an error if the file cannot be opened 3: Read Next Cross-Reference Record - Sequentially read the next record from the Account Cross-Reference file, retrieving the card number (16 characters) and associated cross-reference data (34 characters) 4: Display Cross-Reference Record - Print/display each successfully retrieved cross-reference record containing the card number and its associated account cross-reference data 5: End-of-File Detection - Detect when all records in the Account Cross-Reference file have been processed and signal the program to stop reading 6: Iterative Record Processing - Continuously read and display all cross-reference records sequentially until the end of the file is reached 7: Close Account Cross-Reference File - Close the Account Cross-Reference data file after all records have been processed; terminate the program with an error if the file cannot be closed properly 8: Program Completion - Display a message indicating the successful end of the Account Cross-Reference file reading and printing process

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Program Initialization Announcement-L_2: ```cobol DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT03C'. ``` Open Account Cross-Reference File for Sequential Reading-L_3: ```cobol 0000-XREFFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT XREFFILE-FILE IF XREFFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF ``` File Open Failure Terminates Program-L_4: ```cobol IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING XREFFILE' MOVE XREFFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Sequential Record Processing Loop Initiation-L_5: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT ``` End-of-File Check Controls Loop Continuation-L_6: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' ``` Read Next Cross-Reference Record Sequentially-L_7: ```cobol 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT. READ XREFFILE-FILE INTO CARD-XREF-RECORD. ``` Successful Record Read Triggers Display-L_8: ```cobol IF XREFFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT DISPLAY CARD-XREF-RECORD ``` End-of-File Detection Signals Loop Termination-L_9: ```cobol IF XREFFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ... IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ``` Record Read Failure Terminates Program-L_10: ```cobol ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT ... ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR READING XREFFILE' MOVE XREFFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Display Retrieved Cross-Reference Record-L_11: ```cobol IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CARD-XREF-RECORD END-IF ``` Close Account Cross-Reference File After Processing-L_12: ```cobol 9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE. ADD 8 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT. CLOSE XREFFILE-FILE IF XREFFILE-STATUS = '00' SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT ELSE ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT END-IF ``` File Close Failure Terminates Program-L_13: ```cobol IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING XREFFILE' MOVE XREFFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Program Completion Announcement-L_14: ```cobol DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT03C'. GOBACK. ```
